description:
Vertical 1080x1920, dark navy background. Bold close-up hook in middle 65% of frame (clear of captions). Upper-middle left: large white chat bubble with fg text "What's free Friday?" and small Bot icon (accent=cyan) labeled CHATBOT below it. Mid-right: large Calendar icon (muted=grey) with red Lock overlay. Between them center: vertical red gap bar that pulses. Kinetic typography: huge fg words "CAN'T" then accent3 yellow "Until now." at bottom-middle. Camera slow push-in. Ends with red gap cracking into cyan glow tease to lead to next shot.

Viewer feedback for this new version (follow it): make this in mainm

beats.action: White chat bubble pops in upper-middle left with text What's free Friday? typing in
Bot icon in accent cyan drops below bubble with label CHATBOT
Thick red gap bar slams between bubble and right side, pulsing, big fg word CAN'T flashes
Muted grey Calendar icon with red Lock badge pops in mid-right, shakes as gap blocks it
Camera pushes in, red gap flickers, yellow Until text wipes in bottom-middle
Gap edge turns cyan and glows, words now. pop in accent3 yellow, calendar lock rattles

description: New wide shot, pattern interrupt from close-up to zoomed-out island. Middle zone: centered white chat island box labeled LANGUAGE MODEL TRAPPED IN CHAT with MessageCircle icon, enclosed by dashed muted box walls. Lower-middle: three icons in row - Calendar (accent3 yellow), Plane for flights (accent2 magenta), Database cylinder for Postgres (accent cyan) labeled calendar / flights / postgres. Messy tangled red and muted cables draw between every pair, crossing and flashing. Top-middle empty for incoming MCP reveal. Colors: trapped box muted, cables red for custom mess.

beats.action: Center chat island box scales in with LANGUAGE MODEL label
Dashed muted walls snap around island, model icon dims inside
Yellow Calendar icon pops bottom-left, messy red cable shoots from island and tangles, X flashes
Database cylinder and Plane icons pop bottom-center/right, two more tangled cables cross over first in magenta and cyan
All cables shake, small CodePanel snippets pop on cables showing custom code, red warning badges pulse
Tangled mess freezes, glowing cyan-magenta-yellow MCP plug badge drops top-middle with text ONE STANDARD PLUG, cables orient toward it

description: New split-view shot, left-right layout. Top-center: small chat bubble "what's free Friday?" persists. Mid-left: laptop icon labeled APP + MCP CLIENT (accent cyan card). Mid-right: server rack icon labeled CALENDAR SERVER (accent3 yellow card). Center: single thick glowing cyan cable connecting them with plug icons on ends. Server side holds two tool cards stacked: List events and create event. Bottom-middle: three-step timeline badges Discover - Call - Answer dimmed. Later three busy time blocks (9-11, 11-12:30, 1-3 red blocks) and final answer bubble "You're free after 3pm" with good green check. All motion is packet dots traveling along the single cable.

beats.action: Top chat bubble slides in with what's free Friday? text
Split view wipes in: laptop client left and calendar server right, single cyan cable plugs with glow pop
Cyan packet dot labeled tools/list travels client to server along cable
Two tool cards pop on server: List events and create event in white on dark
List events card turns accent3 yellow and lifts, create event dims to muted, Friday arg chip attaches
Server shows cyan spinner, List card glows as it executes
Three red busy blocks fly as packet server to client along cable into client card
White answer bubble types You're free after 3pm with good green checkmark
Bottom timeline Discover Call Answer badges light cyan-yellow-green in sequence

description: New centered radial payoff that rhymes with hook. Middle: one large glowing cyan universal plug icon. Around it lower-middle: Calendar, Plane, Database icons in clean row connected by straight cyan lines (tangled red mess dissolves outward as particles). Mid-shot shield moment: Lock icon with good green shield labeled password stays on server side, model icon stays left with slash showing no touch. Final frame mirrors hook: left chat bubble What's free Friday? + right Calendar icon now linked by solid cyan cable with green checkmark badge and answer You're free after 3pm. Background same dark navy for clean loop back to scene 0.

beats.action: Mini tangled cables cluster centers and dissolves into particles
Single large cyan universal plug scales in center with glow, clean straight lines shoot to calendar plane database icons
Lock + shield in good green pops on server side, model icon left gets red slash over password text
Scene resets to hook composition but fixed: chat bubble left calendar right now joined by cyan cable, no red gap
Green checkmark lights on calendar, answer You're free after 3pm pulses to hold for loop
